Think step by step: first write down every fact you need and the document it comes from, then do the calculations, then compare. Then give the ANSWER line.
End your reply with exactly one final line in this format:
ANSWER: <district name or yes/no> | <number>
Write the number as a plain number (no units, no thousands separators), rounded to 3 decimal places.

- Lindenmoor (NR-08): area 1,015.7 km², paved road 402.3 km.
- Redfen (NR-09): area 677.1 km², paved road 244.6 km.

Calculations:
- Lindenmoor density: 402.3 / 1,015.7 = 0.396 km road per km² (402.3 / 1015.7 ≈ 0.39612).
- Redfen density: 244.6 / 677.1 = 0.361 km road per km² (244.6 / 677.1 ≈ 0.36128).

Comparison: Lindenmoor has the denser paved road network. The difference is 0.39612 − 0.36128 ≈ 0.03484, which rounds to 0.035 km per km².

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 0.035
